name: System
author: brightwalker25
description: Read-only system panel: thermals, load, storage, network and power

barWidget.description: Temperatures, fans, CPU, memory, disk space, network throughput and power, behind one bar glyph tinted green, amber or red

schema.label: Refresh interval (ms)
schema.description: How often the collector runs while the panel is open. While it is closed it runs once a minute for the bar colour.

schema.label: Per-core bars up to N threads
schema.description: Above this thread count the per-core bars are replaced by a compact strip.

schema.label: Filesystem rows before summarising
schema.description: Root first, then the fullest. The rest are summarised in one line.

schema.label: Colour a filesystem urgent at (%)
schema.description: How full a filesystem has to be before its bar takes the urgent colour.
